app.title: drumclack
app.resident: Closing this window does not quit drumclack; it keeps running in the menu bar / tray. To quit, use Quit in the icon's menu.
nav.label: Sections
status.label: Status
status.permission.denied: Input Monitoring is not allowed, so key presses cannot be detected.
status.permission.unknown: Could not check the Input Monitoring status.
status.permission.stepOpen: In System Settings > Input Monitoring, turn on drumclack.
status.permission.stepRestart: After turning it on, restart drumclack (the change does not apply until you restart).
status.permission.stepPress: After restarting, press any key. If you hear a drum, you are done.
status.permission.reset: If drumclack is already in the list but is still not allowed (for example after updating the app), remove drumclack from the list (−) once, then add it again (+).
status.permission.failed.open: Could not open the settings. Open System Settings > Privacy & Security > Input Monitoring yourself.
status.permission.failed.restart: Could not restart. Quit drumclack once, then start it again.
status.permission.restarting: Restarting… (the window will open again by itself. Please wait.)
status.firstSound.action: Next: press any key. If you hear a drum, you are ready.
status.audio.failed: Could not open the audio output.
status.audio.action: Next step: check that your speakers or headphones are connected and that no other app is using the audio device. It recovers automatically once the output is available.
settings.recovered: The settings file could not be read, so drumclack started with the default settings. The original file is kept in the settings folder (jp.etbs.drumclack) as settings.broken.json.
settings.saveFailed: Could not save the settings. Check that the settings folder is writable.
settings.updateFailed: Could not change the setting. Next step: try changing it again.
settings.loadFailed: Could not load the settings. Next step: restart drumclack.
settings.enabled.label: Play on every key press
settings.enabled.hint: Your settings and assignments are kept even when this is off.
settings.dynamics.hint: How much the volume changes with your typing pace. At 0% every sound has the same volume.
settings.layout.hint: Only changes the keyboard drawing on the Assignments screen.
assign.loadFailed: Could not load the Assignments screen. Next step: restart drumclack.
assign.set.label: Set to edit
assign.hint: Select a key and press Enter (or click) to change its sound. Move between keys with the arrow keys.
assign.keyboard.label: Keyboard diagram
assign.key.label: {key}: {sound} ({source})
assign.menu.label: Sound for {key}
assign.groups.title: Sound per group
assign.overrides.title: Keys changed individually: {count}
assign.overrides.clear.label: Remove the individual setting for {key}
assign.reset.confirm: Restore the {set} assignments to their defaults? Group changes: {groups} / Individual keys: {keys} (total {count}). You can undo it right after.
assign.reset.done: Restored the {set} assignments to their defaults. Items reset: {count}.
assign.undo.done: Undone. The {set} assignments are back as they were.
play.reason.background: The Drumclack window is in the background, so keys sound the way they do while typing. Click this window to bring it to the front and switch to the play assignments.
play.off: Drumclack is off, so pressing keys makes no sound. You can still click a pad to hear it.
play.hint: Click a pad, or press the key shown on it. When you switch to another app, keys go back to the typing assignments.
play.pad.label: {sound}. Assigned keys: {keys}
play.mode.off: Drumclack is off (keys make no sound)
play.hint.off: Click a pad to hear it.
play.exit: To leave this section with the keyboard, press Tab to move to the tabs, then press Enter.
